privacy: Only AutoSouk admins see your documents. Every view is logged.

kind.title: How do you work?
kind.description: We check every mechanic before buyers can book them. Choose how you work, and we'll ask for the right documents.
kind.soloDescription: You inspect cars yourself, at the seller's place or on the road. No workshop needed.
kind.garageDescription: You run a workshop. Buyers see its address, and you can inspect cars there.

notSubmitted.soloDescription: Both sides of your national ID card. An admin checks the name matches your account.
notSubmitted.garageDescription: They show you have the right to run the garage. An admin checks them by hand, usually within 2 working days.

pending.title: We're checking your documents
pending.description: An admin reviews them by hand, usually within 2 working days. We'll email you when it's done.
pending.whileYouWaitDescription: Set up your workshop profile: photos, address and price. Buyers can book you once your documents are approved.

approved.title: You're a verified mechanic
approved.description: Buyers can book you until {{date}}. Upload the new document before then.

rejected.title: A document needs a fix
rejected.description: Buyers can't book you until every document is approved. Replace the ones below and send them again.

expired.title: A document expired
expired.description: Buyers can't book you until you upload a valid one and an admin approves it.

tips.readable: Whole document in frame, no glare or blur: every number must be readable

tile.wrongType: Choose a JPG, PNG or PDF file.
tile.tooLarge: This file is larger than 10 MB.
tile.failed: The file didn't arrive. Check your connection and upload it again.
